description: Minified JavaScript source code for the noUiSlider library, which provides slider UI components with various configuration options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new slider on a DOM element with specified options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the slider instance from the DOM element.

methods.name: steps
methods.description: Returns the array of step values for the slider.

methods.name: setHandle
methods.description: Sets the position of a specific handle.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the slider to its initial start values.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the slider, preventing user interaction.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the slider for user interaction.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates the slider's configuration options dynamically.
